/des na bstod pa nyi shu pa'i ṭī kar gang gi lhag pa'i rgyab zhal rnams ni bung ba ltar nag pa zhes gsungs pa dang / khas blangs 'gal ba'i skyon yang med de/ rgyab zhal gyi don zhal nag po bzhi nub tu blta ba yin pa 'gog pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa'i bzhed pa rje btsun chen po bzhed pa ltar yin pa yang 'dir gnod byed du mi 'jug ste/ de ltar du khas len pa'i phyir ro/ /zhabs kyi bzhugs stabs kyi skabs su gnad kyi zla zer las/ zhabs bzhi g.yas gnyis brkyang pa'i brla la g.yon bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa yin par lung rigs kyi sgrub byed dogs spong dang bcas te rgyas par gsungs pa la/ nyi zer las/ 'di yang rnam par brtag pa bya ste nag po pa la sogs pa'i rgya gzhung du ma'i dgongs pa yin kyang rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa de kho na ma yin te/ nā ro 'grel chen las/ gtso bo la gar stabs kyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa zhes gsungs shing / 'khor la skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa zhes gsungs pa dang / 'jam dpal ye shes zhabs kyis kyang / gtso bo la nyi ma la bzhugs stangs mi 'dra bar shin tu gsal ba'i phyir dang / byang chub snying pos/ bdud bzhi rim par zhabs kyis mnan/ /zhes dang / zhabs bzhi pa la mnan pa yis/ /lha dang lha min 'jigs par byed/ /ces pas zhabs mdun rgyab bzhi ka mtho lnga rnam par brgyangs pa'i g.yas brkyang gis bdud re re mnan pa lta bur gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /khyad par du yang rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi lugs la mtsho skyes lugs dang / 'grel pa lugs dang / man ngag lugs gsum char gyi dgongs pa yang zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa la/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyi bzhugs pa yin te/ bstod pa nyi shu par/ zhabs bzhi pos ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid/ /ces gsungs pa dang /

mi thub zla bas/ bdud bzhi zhabs kyis mnan pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / shān+ti pas/ dbus su bdud ni bzhi po ste/ /gong nas gong du bkan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams dang mthun par sa chen gyis/ pad nyi'i steng du gtso bo la bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan zhes dang / rje btsun rtse mos de'i steng du bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan zhes dang / rje btsun chen pos/ dbus kyi pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan zhes gsungs pas/ rgya gzhung de rnams dang / man ngag lugs phal che ba la bdud bzhi rim par steng 'og tu brtsegs pa'i gdan du bzhed la/ de'i steng du bzhugs tshul yang bstod pa nyi shu pa las/ nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang bskum/ /gar mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshig rkang dang pos zhabs mdun ma g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum par bstan la/ gnyis pas rgyab ma gar stabs su bzhugs par bstan pas/ mtsho skyes kyi dgongs pa de ltar du grub bo/ /gal te lung de'i don ni de ltar ma yin te/ zla zer nyid las gzhan lugs 'gog pa'i skabs su bstod pa nyi shu par/ nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang sngo/ /zhes bod dpe rnying pa thams cad dang / rgya dpe las 'byung gi bskum zhes pa mi 'byung la gal te 'byung na bstod pa der/ sku mdog gi sgo nas bstod pa cig kyang ma bstan par thal ba'i skyon yod do/ /zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ bskum zhes pa'i dpe rnying ma mthong ba'i phyir na/ bod dpe rnying pa thams cad las/ nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang sngo/ /zhes 'ba' zhig 'byung ba'i rtags kyang ma grub la/ khyab pa'ang ma nges te de ltar na bskum zhes pa mi 'byung na gzhung der mdun zhabs g.yon pa la bstod pa gcig kyang ma bstan par thal ba'i skyon yod do/ /gal te gar mdzad ces pa'i khongs nas mdun zhabs g.yon pa'i bstod pa'ang ston snyam na/ 'o na spyi bo dang steng nag po mdzes zhes pa'i dang zhes pa ni/

dang po'i zhal de rtsa zhal yin la/ de nag por bstan pa'i khongs nas sku mdog gi bstod pa'ang bstan no zhes mtshungs so/ /des na mtsho skyes kyi dgongs pa sngar 'chad pa ltar yin te/ rje btsun rtse mos mtsho skyes kyi 'grel pa'i lung khyed rang gis drangs pa las/ zhabs g.yas gnyis kyis mnan pa zhes pa ni yi ge ma dag pa yin nges kyi kho bos dpe mi gcig pa du ma mthong ba na zhabs g.yas pa nyid kyis mnan pa shas dag tu snang bas de bzhin yin la lung der yang / g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gar stabs kyi dag pa gsum so sor gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te snying khar zhabs g.yas pa nyid kyis mnan pa zhes gsungs pas/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs 'ba' zhig tu bstan no snyam na ma yin te/ lung des bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i snying khar zhabs g.yas pa kho nas mnan par bstan gyi zhabs g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i rkang pa nas ma mnan par dngos shugs gang la yang ma bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /'grel pa lugs la yang 'dug stangs de nyid yin te rin chen 'bar ba las/ nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum lhag ma gar gyi tshul gyis bzhengs/ zhes shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la rin chen 'bar ba dang / a bha ya'i lung de'i dgongs pa zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang ba'i brla la g.yon bskum nas sor mo sbyar ba dang / lhag ma rgyab ma gnyis mdun ma lta bu'i gar stabs kyi tshul gyis bzhengs pa ltar 'bru brnan du rung na slob dpon thams cad dgongs pa gcig par 'gyur bas shin tu legs kyi gzhan du na slob dpon 'di gnyis kyang mi mkhas par 'gyur ba'i skyon yod de/ rgyud dang mi mthun pa'i phyir zhes zer ba ni ha cang thal te/ de ltar na khyed rang gis drangs pa'i jo bos/ steng na zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang bzhugs/ /zhes dang / kaṃ pa las/ gtso bo'i zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs g.yas brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyi bzhugs par bstan pa'i lung thams cad kyang /

zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa/ mtho lnga rnam par brgyangs pa'i gar gyis bzhugs stabs dang / rgyab ma gnyis g.yas brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon bskum pa'i sor mo sbyar ba'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa yin zhes bshad na/ slob dpon thams cad dgongs pa gcig tu gyur pas legs so zhes rnam pa kun tu mtshungs so/ /man ngag lugs kyi dgongs pa yang de bzhin yin te/ rje btsun rtse mos mngon rtogs rgyas par bsgom bya'i skabs su gcer bu zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas bzhugs pa zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs kyang / dag pa dran pa'i skabs su/ thugs rje chen pos sems can la khyab pas na mya ngan las 'das pa la mi bzhugs par bstan pa'i phyir zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'o/ /shes rab kyis chos gang yang mi 'dzin pas 'khor ba la mi bzhugs par bstan pa'i phyir zhabs g.yon bskum pa'o/ /gar mkhan ltar cha lugs sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pas na gar mkhan gyi cha lugs su skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o zhes bdud bzhi brtsegs gdan gyi tshul du yod pa la zhabs g.yas brkyangs/ g.yon bskum/ gar stabs gsum dag pa so sor gsungs la de nyid gsal por bya ba'i phyir/ 'phags pas zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa zhes dang / srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis mnan pas rtsa ba'i zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la bzhugs pas rgyab ma gnyis kyis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o zhes gsungs pas so/ /gzhan yang rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i gdan gyi rnam dag las/ bdud bzhi bkram gdan gyi dbang du byas nas kyang zhabs mdun ma gnyis brkyang zhing g.yon bskum/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa yin par shin tu gsal bar bshad pas/ sems rnal du phob la gzu bo'i blos dpyod cig 'o na gong du drangs pa'i nyi mar bzhugs shing gar stabs ldan zhes rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa ji ltar drangs snyam na/

de'i don skyil krung phyed pa'i gar dang ldan pa kho nar 'chad pa ma yin gyi/ de'i don gar mkhan ltar cha lugs rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin te zhes bya ba bris so/ /'di dag ni mi 'thad de/ de la thog mar nā ro 'grel chen dang / 'jam dpal ye shes zhabs kyis 'khor la skyil krung phyed par gsung shing / gtso bo la dmigs bsal ma gsungs pas/ gtso bo'i skyil krung phyed pa 'gog mi nus te/ gal te nus na khyed rang man ngag lugs sogs lugs gsum po la zhabs rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs su bzhugs par 'dod pa de yang sun 'byin par 'gyur te/ lugs gsum po de la 'khor la skyil krung phyed pa dngos su ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub snying po'i dgongs pa zhabs bzhi ga mtho lnga rnam par brgyangs pa'i g.yas brkyang gis bdud re re mnan pa la 'chad pa dang / mtsho skyes dang / mi thub zla ba'i dgongs pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs par 'chad pa ni ci rung rung du smras pa ste/ byang chub snying pos/ bdud bzhi rim par zhabs kyis mnan/ /zhes gsungs pa bdud bzhi rim pa bzhin du zhabs bzhis rim pa bzhin du mnan pa la 'chad na/ mtsho skyes kyis/ zhabs bzhi pos ni bdud bzhi po/ /mnyam par mnan cing zhes pa yang zhabs re res bdud bzhi po re re mnyam par mnan pa la 'chad dgos shing / bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan ces pa'i don bdud bzhi brtsegs pa la 'chad na/ bdud bzhi rim par zhes pa'i don yang bdud bzhi rim par brtsegs pa la 'chad dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi lugs la/ mtsho skyes lugs/ 'grel pa lugs/ man ngag lugs gsum char gyi dgongs pa zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa yin pa'i shes byed du/ lugs gsum po de dag gi gzhung rnams las bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan du gsungs pa drangs pa rnams ni lugs snga phyi ma phyed pa lta bur snang ste/

bdud bzhi brtsegs gdan ni skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs su bzhugs pa'i shes byed du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /bstod pa nyi shu par/ nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang bskum/ /zhes pa'i zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum bstan par 'dod pa ni gzhung de nyid dang 'gal te/ gzhung de ltar du yod na yang zhabs g.yas pa la brkyang ba dang bskum pa gnyis yod ces par 'chad dgos kyi/ g.yas pa bskum pa'i don g.yon pa bskum pa la 'chad pa ni bzhad gad kyi gnas yin no/ /gnad kyi zla zer las/ nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang dang sngo/ /zhes pa'i 'gyur du yod par gsungs la/ dgag pa brjod pa rnams ni mi 'thad de/ sngo zhes pa rje btsun nyid kyis gzigs pa'i bod dpe rnying pa thams cad las 'byung zhes gsungs pas/ khyed dpe ma dag pa dang thug pa mi 'gog pa'i phyir dang / bskum zhes pa mi 'byung na mdun zhabs g.yon pa la bstod pa cig kyang ma bstan par thal ba'i skyon yod do zhes sogs kyi mtshungs pa bsgre ba ni/ phyogs snga phyi so sor ma phyed pa'i mtshungs pa snang ba'i phyir te/ gzhung de ltar du yod na yang mdun zhabs g.yon pa bskum pa mi ston par bshad zin cing / gal te bstan na yang nged la gnod pa cung zad kyang med de/ nged zhabs g.yon pa gnyis char bskum pa bzhed pa'i phyir ro/ /mtsho skyes kyi 'grel par zhabs g.yas pa gnyis kyis mnan pa zhes pa dpe ma dag par byas nas zhabs g.yas pa nyid kyis mnan pa zhes par yod pas/ rang lugs sgrub par 'dod pa ni rang lugs 'gog par byed pa ste/ khyed rang gis 'bru gnyer ba ltar bdud bzhi'i snying khar zhabs g.yas pa kho nas mnan pa'i don du 'dod na yang / zhabs g.yas pa gnyis char gyis bdud bzhi'i snying kha nas mnan par khas len dgos la/ de'i tshe zhabs rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed par bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yas pa'i thad du yang snying kha yod par khas len dgos pa'i phyir na/

bdud kyi snying ga de bdud kyi lto ba thams cad la khyab nas yod par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /mtsho skyes kyi 'grel par g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dang / skyil krung phyed pa gsum la dag pa so sor gsungs pas de gsum so sor yod par mi 'grub ste 'grel par rol pa'i tshul ni skyil krung phyed pa'o/ /de'i g.yas brkyang pa ni thugs rje chen pos sems can la khyab pa'o zhes skyil krung phyed pa de yi g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyi dag pa gsungs par shin tu gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /man ngag lugs kyi dgongs pa la/ rje btsun rtse mos bsgom bya'i skabs su gcer bu g.yas brkyang pas bzhugs pa zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs kyang / dag pa dran pa'i skabs su g.yas brkyang / g.yon bskum dang / skyil krung phyed pa gsum gyis dag pa gsungs pas/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum las logs su gyur pa'i skyil krung phyed pa yod par 'grub par 'dod pa yang shin tu mi 'thad de/ sngar mtsho skyes kyi 'grel pa'i lugs dang don gcig pa'i phyir dang / gzhan du rje btsun chen pos bde mchog lo dril gnyis kyi skabs su/ g.yas dang po rdo rje dang / g.yon dang po dril bu 'dzin pa dang / yum la 'khyud pa'i dag pa gsum so sor gsungs pas rdor dril 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis las logs su gyur pa'i yum la 'khyud pa'i phyag gnyis yod par khas len dgos par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i gdan gyi rnam dag las/ gtso bo'i zhabs phyed krung du bzhugs pas tshangs pa'i snying kha nas mnan pa dang zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dbang phyug chen po'i snying kha nas mnan pa dang / g.yon bskum pas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdud sdig can gyi snying kha nas mnan pa dang / yum gyi zhabs g.yon pas brgya byin gyis snying kha nas mnan par gsungs kyi/ zhabs mdun rgyab kyi gsal kha mi snang bas 'di'ang bdud bzhi bkram gdan gyi dbang du byas pa yin par mi 'grub ste/

'di yang bdud bzhi brtsegs gdan gyi dbang du byas nas gtso bo'i zhabs thams cad kyi nus pa sdom nas zhabs g.yas pa gnyis dang / yum gyi zhabs g.yon pa gsum gyis bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i snying kha nas mnan pa'i don du snang ba'i phyir ro/ /sems rnal du phab nas gzu bo'i blos dpyad pa'i tshe ji ltar 'byung ba dgongs mdzod cig nyi mar bzhugs shing gar stabs ldan/ /zhes pa'i don gar mkhan ltar cha lugs sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa la 'chad pa ni rnam par 'khyams te/ de ltar na sangs rgyas thams cad gar mkhan ltar cha lugs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas skyil krung gis bzhugs pa rnams la yang gar stabs ldan zhes gsung dgos par thal lo/ /dran pa'i 'byung gnas las rnam pa sna tshogs su spro bas na gar dang ldan no zhes pa'i don ni gar gyi rnam dag 'chad pa yin gyi gar gyi bzhugs stabs 'chad pa ma yin no/ /yang nyi zer las bod kyi 'khrul spong mkhan pos rtsa rgyud kyi ṭī kar/ man ngag lugs la sems dpa' sum brtsegs 'chad pas nor ro zhes bkag pa la/ gnad kyi zla zer las/ de'i skyon spong nas man ngag lugs la sems dpa' sum brtsegs yod par sgrub bo/ /de la phyogs snga ni zla zer gyi lan des kyang khegs mod zla zer gyi lugs de la'ang cung zad dpyad na/ rje btsun chen pos bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs su/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi rnam bzhag gnyis gsungs pa khyed kyis bshad pa ltar yin mod/ de yang man ngag lugs kyi dbang du byas pa ma yin gyi sgrub thabs 'di 'grel pa lugs dang / man ngag lugs thun mong ba'i nang nas 'grel pa lugs shas che bar snang bas/ de'i phyir bdud rtsi 'od kyi rjes su 'brang nas sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi tha snyad gsungs pa yin la/ man ngag lugs kyi gsungs rab 'grel byed gang du yang sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi tha snyad gsungs pa med pas thugs khar sa bon 'god pa tsam las mi mdzad do/

/sgron gsal gyi lung gi don ni khyed kyis bshad pa ltar legs pas sa bon thig les brgyan pa yod pa rnams la sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi don tshang ba legs par grub bo/ /zhes bya ba bris so/ /de la bod kyi 'khrul spong mkhan pos rtsa rgyud ṭī kar/ de ltar du yod pa zla zer las bkag ces pa ni tshod dpag tsam du snang ste/ des rtsa rgyud kyi ṭī ka 'gog pa la rtsol ba mi mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang de zhar la khegs mod kyi/ zla zer gyi phyogs snga ni gzhan zhig ni yod do/ /rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs man ngag lugs ma yin par 'grel pa lugs su 'dod pa ni sngar bkag zin la/ man ngag lugs la sems dpa' sum brtsegs yod na thugs khar sa bon 'god pa tsam las mi mdzad ces pa'i tsam sgras gang gcod pa yin smra dgos la/ med na sa bon thig les brgyan pa yod pa rnams la sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi don tshang ba legs par grub ces khas blangs pa dang 'gal lo/ /gnad kyi zla zer las/ bla chen 'phags pas rang gi thugs kha nas sngags phreng thon/ yum gyi khar zhugs thugs khar thim/ mkha' nang nas thon/ yab kyi rdo rjer zhugs thugs khar thim par bsgoms la bzlas shing / 'khor rnams kyi rang rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon la 'khor bar bsam zhing bzla'o/ /zhes gsungs mod/ rje btsun dang mi mthun par mngon no zhes gsungs pa la/ nyi zer las/ de'ang mi 'thad de gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ rje btsun sku mched kyi zhal nas tshur 'khor du bshad pa ni rlung brtan par bya ba'i dbang du byas te/ rje sa skya pa chen pos bzlas pa'i man ngag ni/ yum gyi thugs kha'i aṃ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste/ rang gi khar zhugs te tshur 'khor ba 'dis ni rlung brtan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa ltar mdzad pa yin la/ de'i shugs las byung sems brtan par 'dod pas phar 'khor du bzla ba snyan brgyud la bzhugs pa 'phags pa rin po ches gsal bar bkod pa yin te/

rje btsun gyis yum dang bcas pa la/ 'do la'i bzlas pa dang zhes pa rgyas bshad kyi skabs su 'phags pas 'khor ba'i bzlas pa la gnyis su med pa las yab yum zhal sbyor gyi steng 'og gi sgo gnyis nas phar tshur 'khor bas rang bzhin gyi don byas par bsam zhing bzla ba dang zhes gsungs pas so/ /'di nyid rje btsun chen po'i dgongs par shin tu gsal te/ de kho na nyid gsum gyi man ngag las/ kyai rdo rje dang / bde mchog yum la 'khor ba'i bzlas pa zhes bya ba yum las yab kyi sngags kyi 'od zer dang yig 'bru tshur 'khor ba'am/ yab las yum la phar 'khor ba'i tshul du bzlas par bshad de/ de yang tshur 'khor nas bzlas na rlung brtan par 'gyur/ phar 'khor du bzlas na byang chub kyi sems brtan par 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang bzlas thabs gzhung so so gang gi lugs su byas kyang btub ste/ bzlas thabs kyi bye brag go zhes shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor gyi sngags bzla tshul yang rje btsun rtse mos sngags kyi 'od zer lha mo la phog pas/ thugs brgyud bskul bar bsam zhes gsungs pa ni/ bzla tshul gyi rnam grangs gzhan yin la/ rje btsun gyi dgongs pa yang mtha' gcig pa ma yin te/ rje btsun gyis yum med pa la ni ma ning gi bzlas pa zhes gsungs la/ rgyas bshad du 'phags pas yab yum rkyang pa la 'khor bar bsgom pa ma ning gi bzlas pa zhes gsungs so/ /gal te rje btsun gyis yum med pa la zhes gsungs pa ni/ sku rdo rje yum med pa la dgongs pa yin gyi/ lha mo rnams la ma yin no snyam na lha mo rnams la yang tshul de nyid du bzla ba rje btsun gyi dgongs pa yin te/ rje btsun gyis bdag med pa'i mngon rtogs su thugs kha'i aṃ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste/ lte ba nas thon nas zhal nas zhugs te/ thugs ka'i aṃ la thim pa'i tshul gyis tshur 'khor gyi rnam pa'am zhal nas byung ste/ lte bar zhugs nas aṃ la mas yar thim pa'i tshul gyis phar 'khor gyi rnam par bzlas pa gang rung ngo zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/des na 'do la'i bzlas pa dang / ma ning gi bzlas pa gnyis ka la yang phar 'khor dang tshur 'khor du bzlas pa lugs gnyis ka yod pa rje btsun gyi dgongs pa yin par gsal bar bshad pas/ 'phags pa rin po ches bzlas pa'i man ngag rje btsun sku mched dang mi mthun pa ma yin par shes par gyis shig ces bya ba bris so/ /'di la dpyad par bya ste/ rje btsun sku mched kyis sgrub thabs gnyis las tshur 'khor ma gtogs pa phar 'khor ma bshad pas 'phags pas phar 'khor du bshad pa rje btsun gyi gsung dang mi mthun par mngon zhes gsungs kyi/ phar 'khor gtan mi rung bar bzhed pa ni ma yin la de kho na nyid gsum gyi man ngag las/ tshur 'khor ma gtogs pa phar 'khor yod pa sgrub mi nus te/ lung de'i don ni kyai rdor dang / bde mchog gnyis la tshur 'khor dang / phar 'khor gnyis po so sor sbyar ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na kyai rdor gyi skabs su rlung brtan pa'i dbang du byas nas tshur 'khor dang / bde mchog gi skabs su byang chub kyi sems brtan pa'i dbang du byas nas phar 'khor du bya bar bshad pas gnas skabs ma 'dres pa so sor nyams su longs shig 'khor gyi sngags bzlas pa'i tshul rje btsun rtse mos sngags kyi 'od zer lha mo la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul bar bsams zhes gsungs pa rje btsun gyi dgongs pa mtha' gcig pa ma yin pa'i shes byed du/ yum med pa la ma ning gi bzlas pa zhes pa drangs pa ni 'brel med de/ de ni yum med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'am/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i bzlas tshul ston pa'i phyir ro/ /yang de yum med pa sku rdo rje lta bu la dgongs pa ma yin pa'i shes byed du rje btsun gyi bdag med ma'i mngon rtogs su/ thugs ka'i aṃ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste zhes sogs drangs pas kyang 'khor gyi lha mo rnams la 'khor tshul de lta bu byed par sgrub mi nus te/

de ni bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo la dgongs pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te sgrub nus na yang / des 'phags pas 'khor rnams kyi ni/ rang rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon la 'khor bar bsam zhing bzla'o zhes pa de sgrub mi nus te/ de gnyis la 'brel mi 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /des na kho bo'i bla mas spyir 'do la'i bzlas pa dang / ma ning gi bzlas pa gnyis ka la phar 'khor dang tshur 'khor du bzla ba'i lugs gnyis med pa ma gsungs la/ 'on kyang kyai rdor dang bde mchog gnyis la tshur 'khor dang phar 'khor so sor sbyar ba ni rje btsun gong ma'i gsung la shin tu gsal bas de las ldog pa gcig byed pa la dgos pa ci zhig sgrub/ gtor chog gi ṭī kar kha cig chos 'byung gcig gi nang du pad+ma gsum ka 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ de nyid bcu par gong ma gong ma'i rim pas chos 'byung sum brgyud kyi dbus su chud pa/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bltas la zhes dang / slob dpon kaṃ pa las chos 'byung sum brtsegs bar mar ni zhes dang / mar me mdzad kyi steng gi chos 'byung pad+ma dkar zhes dang / 'og gi chos 'byung pad+ma dmar zhes dang / rje btsun rtse mos dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs 'og gi cha la chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad la zhes sogs dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i skabs nas gsungs shing / rje btsun gyis steng gi chos 'byung gi pad+ma zhes dang / bar gyi chos 'byung gi pad+ma zhes dang / chos 'byung 'og ma'i pad+ma zhes dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pa la/ nyi zer las/ de la chos 'byung sum brtsegs kho na mtha' gcig tu 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ a la la badz+ra gyis mdun du gru gsum chos 'byung nang du pad+ma sum brtsegs bsam ste zhes dang / mi thub zla bas/ chos kyi 'byung gnas nang du ni/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs su/ /zhes dang / sa chen gyis gtor ma gtong na mdun du chos 'byung gi nang du paṃ las pad+ma sum brtsegs bltas la zhes dang /

rje btsun rtse mos mngon rtogs rgyas par khyed rang gi drangs pa'i lung de'i snga rol de nyid du de la mgron bskyed pa ni mdun du dkyil 'khor ma byas na/ skad cig gis chos 'byung bsgoms te de'i nang du paṃ sum brtsegs las pad+ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs bsgoms te zhes dang / dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas kyang / chos 'byung gcig po'i nang du gtor mgron rnams bsgom par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te nub bam lho nub kyi 'og gi cha la chos 'byung gi nang du zhes drangs pa'i lung gi chos 'byung sum brtsegs su 'grub bo snyam na mi 'grub ste/ de ni 'og gi gtor mgron rnams phyi'i chos 'byung gi nang du chud pa la dgongs kyi/ sgos kyi chos 'byung nges par bzhed pa ni ma yin ste/ yin na steng gi gtor mgron rnams la yang / sgos kyi chos 'byung gsungs par rigs pa la/ rje btsun rtse mos/ de'i shar ram/ byang shar gyi steng gi cha la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi oṃ dgu las lte ba la sku rdo rje/ 'dab ma la lha chen po brgyad/ ces pa tsam las steng gi mgron rnams la chos 'byung ma gsungs 'i phyir ro/ /des na chos 'byung sum brtsegs sam/ chos 'byung gcig gi nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs byed pa 'dam kha can du shes par bya'o zhes bya ba bris so/ /de la lung de rnams las chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs yod par gsungs kyi chos 'byung gcig gi nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs yod par ma gsungs la/ gnad kyi zla zer las drangs pa'i lung rnams las ni chos 'byung sum brtsegs dngos su gsungs pas/ a la la badz+ra dang / mi thub zla ba sogs kyi lung gi don yang / chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa zhes pa'i don du snang ste/ dper na bum pa'i nang du chus gang ba sum brtsegs ces pas bum pa chus gang ba sum brtsegs ston gyi bum pa'i nang du chu sum brtsegs yod pa mi ston pa bzhin no/

/rje btsun rtse mos lho nub kyi 'og gi cha la chos 'byung gi nang du zhes gsungs pa'i don/ 'og gi gtor mgron rnams phyi'i chos 'byung gi nang du chud pa la dgongs zhes pa ni ha cang thal te/ de lta bu'i dogs pa med pa'i phyir dang / gal te yod na srung 'khor gyi nang du chud mi chud kyi dogs pa yang yod pas/ srung 'khor gyi nang du zhes pa yang dogs par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /'og gi gtor mgron la sgos kyi chos 'byung nges par bzhed nas de ltar du gsungs na steng gi gtor mgron la yang sgos kyi chos 'byung gsung bar rigs zhes pa ni/ khyed rang la mtshungs te/ 'og gi gtor mgron phyi'i chos 'byung gi nang du chud pa la dgongs nas chos 'byung gi nang du zhes gsungs na steng gi gtor mgron la yang de ltar du dgos par thal bar mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na de nyid bcu pa la sogs pa'i rgya bod kyi gzhung khungs thub rnams las chos 'byung sum brtsegs dngos su gsungs shing / chos 'byung gcig gi nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad sum brtsegs byed pa'i gsal kha can gyi gzhung khungs thub gcig kyang med pa'i phyir dang / a la la badz+ra/ mi thub zla ba/ sa chen/ rje btsun rtse mo'i lung rnams kyi don yang chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad yod pa de lta bu sum brtsegs ces pa yin pas 'dam kha can ma yin par shes par bya'o/ /gtor chog gi ṭī kar/ 'phags pa rin po ches rdo rje gsum gyi dbang du mdzad nas/ g.yas pa rnams 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ pad+ma g.yon pa rnams kyis de dag gis yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin par bshad pa la/ kha cig a la la badz+ra gyi gtor chog las/ dkar po brtag pa'i dbu rgyan can/ /'khor lo dril bus lag pa sbrel/ /sngon po mi bskyod cod paṇa can/ /rdo rje dril bus lag gnyis sbrel/ /dmar po snang mtha'i dbu rgyan can/ /pad+ma dril bus lag pa sbrel/ /zhes bshad do zer te/

gzhung de mthong na dpyad zer ba la/ nyi zer mkhan po na re/ kho bos gzhung de mthong ba na phyag mtshan de kho na bzhin du bzhugs kyin 'dug kyang de'i lugs la steng ma khyung mgo bar ma srin po'i mgo 'og ma chu srin mgor bshad 'dug pas de nas bshad pa'i lugs de 'dir blangs pa ma yin par snang mod/ 'on kyang 'phags pa rin po ches/ de ltar gsungs pa ni/ gong ma'i gdams ngag snyan brgyud du shes par bya'o zhes bya ba bris so/ /de ni 'phags pa'i bzhed pa sgrub par rlom yang / sgrub byed gtan med pa gcig thon snang ste/ lugs de la a la la badz+ra gyi gtor chog las de ltar du bshad pa las gzhan pa'i sgrub byed med cing / gzhung de yang sgrub byed ma yin par khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /gong ma'i man ngag snyan brgyud du shes par bya zhes pa yang dam bca' tsam ste/ man ngag lugs kyi yig cha gang du yang de ltar ma gsungs shing / rgyud las/ rdo rje dril bus lag pa sbrel/ /zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /yum gyi phyag mtshan gyi skabs su gtor chog gi ṭī kar/ kha cig gri gug dang thod par byed pa ni rgyud rgya gzhung gong ma'i gsung rab thams cad nas mi 'byung bas 'dir/ rang mtshungs rig mas lus sprad nas/ /zhes gsungs pa yab dang mtshungs par bya'o zhes gsungs pa la/ nyi zer las/ de la rgyud de'i don yab dang mdog mtshungs pa tsam la dgongs te mi thub zla bas/ rang mdog rig mas yan lag 'khyud/ /ces dang / rin chen 'bar ba las kyang / tshig de nyid gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'phags pa rin po ches/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rig ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud ces gsungs pa ltar 'thad kyi/ rang mtshungs zhes pas phyag mtshan yang mtshungs mi dgos te/ dgos na/ shes rab rdo rje phag mo ni bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs can no/ /zhes pa'i skabs kyi phag mo'i phyag mtshan yang yab dang mtshungs dgos par 'gyur bas ha cang thal lo zhes bya ba bris so/

/de ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ mi thub zla bas/ rang mdog rig mas yan lag 'khyud/ /ces mdog mtshungs la sbyar yang / phyag mtshan logs su ma gsungs pa'i phyir dang / shes rab rdo rje phag mo ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs can no/ /zhes pa dang mi mtshungs te/ der rdo rje phag mo dang lu gu rgyud gnyis la bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs can no zhes spyir btang nas/ 'on kyang gri gug dang thod pa'o zhes phyag mtshan gyi dmigs bsal rgyud las dngos su gsungs shing / gur las/ rang mtshungs rig mas lus sprad nas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mjug tu/ rdo rje dril bus lag pa sbrel/ /zhes phyag mtshan thun mong du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na legs par soms la smros shig rgyas btab kyi skabs su gtor chog gi ṭī kar/ kha cig kyai rdo rje phyogs skyong brgyad dang bcas pa la mi bskyod pa zhes thams cad la mi bskyod pas rgyas 'debs pa dang / sru lung pas/ gtso bo yab yum gau rī dang / /puk+ka sī la mi bskyod pa/ /zhes sogs sgrub thabs ltar byed pa gnyis las/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na/ dbus su dkyil 'khor gsar du bskyed dgos la/ de la yang yan lag bzhi ma rdzogs na cho ga ma tshang bar rnal 'byor dbang phyug bzhed cing / thams cad kyi rigs bdag mi bskyod pa ma yin pas phyi ma legs par mthong ngo zhes gsungs pa la/ nyi zer las/ gur rgyan du bar du hūm̐ dgu las lte bar thugs rdo rje'am lha dgu'am/ bzhi bcu zhe dgu phyogs skyong brgyad kyis bskor ba nag po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can dang zhes gsungs pas gtso bo la rgyas btab dngos su ngag 'don la gsungs nas 'khor rnams la rigs bdag dran pa tsam gyis chog pa rje btsun gyi dgongs pa yin par sems la de ltar byas pas yan lag bzhi ma tshang ba'i skyon las kyang grol lo/ /des na 'phags pa rin po ches kyai rdo rje phyogs skyong brgyad dang bcas pa la mi bskyod pa zhes gsungs pa tsam gyis lha mo brgyad la yang mi bskyod pas rgyas btab par khas len mi dgos te/

lha mo brgyad po kyai rdor du khas ma blangs pa'i phyir ro zhes bris so/ /'di ma brtags pa chen po ste/ gur rgyan las/ mi bskyod pa yi dbu rgyan can/ /zhes pas/ gtso bo la rgyas gdab dngos su ngag 'don la gsungs pa yin na/ lung de'i gong gi nag po zhes pas kyang gtso bo'i kha dog dngos su gsungs par khas len dgos pas/ lha zhe dgu byed pa'i tshe rigs gzhan bzhi'i kha dog kyang nag por 'gyur ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gur rgyan gyi lung gi don ni/ dbus su dkyil 'khor gang bsgoms pa'i rigs bdag sgrub thabs ltar du sgom pa gzhir bzhag pa yin te rje btsun rtse mos lha chen brgyad la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ klu chen brgyad la 'od dpag med kyis/ lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la rang rang gi rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan par bya'o zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na nag po mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan zhes pas phyogs skyong brgyad kyi kha dog dang rigs bdag ston pa yin la/ de yang gtso 'khor thams cad rigs bdag rang chas can du bsgoms pa'i yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byed pa'i skabs yin gyi gtso bo la dbang bskur nas rgyas gdab pa dang / 'khor rnams la rigs bdag dran pa tsam byed pa'i lugs ni man ngag lugs la med do/ /'phags pa'i bzhed pa ni kyai rdor lha dgu char la mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab pa yin te/ gzhan du 'khor la rgyas 'debs mi dgos pa'am rigs bdag dran pa tsam gyis chog na/ phyogs skyong brgyad la yang mtshungs pa las/ phyogs skyong brgyad la rgyas 'debs dngos su gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na gnad kyi zla zer ni kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs bod du 'gyur ro 'tshal mtha' dag dang / khyad par rje btsun bir+wa pa'i bka' srol man ngag lugs dang / 'grel pa lugs gnyis kyi nyams len gyi cha gsal bar ston pa la 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa yin kyang nyi zer mkhan pos/

rang gi grub mtha' snga ma nyes pa dang ma mthun pa rnams la 'khyog po'i tshul gyis skyon spong mang po smras 'dug pa rnams la/ kho bos chos mthun gyi lan btab pa yin pas/ gzu bor gnas pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis tshul bzhin du dpyad nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgra chen po bsgrag par gyis shig/ ༈ //kun mkhyen gsung gi nam mkha' yangs par/ /dga' bzhi'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs rdzogs/ /mkhas mang gza' skar dbus na lham me/ /smra ba'i zla ba bzang po las byung / /bskyed rim gsal ba'i gnad kyi zla zer/ /mi shes gdung ba skyob pa'i bsil zer/ /mkhas par rlom pa 'ga' yis 'gog zer/ /'gog byed yi ge'i ming la ci zer/ /'khrul 'joms ming can 'khrul pa'i nyi zer/ /lan med tshe na smra ba mang zer/ /ma dpyad blo ngor de yis chog zer/ /'di ltar dpyad tshe lan du ci zer/ /deng nas bzung ste blo gros ldan rnams/ /bla ma'i gsung rab dbang gi rgyal po/ /sgrib par byed pa'i log rtog dri ma/ /kho bos legs bshad chu 'dis sbyangs nas/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor/ /mchod par byed na dgos 'dod ma lus/ /'bad med lhun grub 'byung bar 'gyur zhes/ /gsang mtho'i skad kyis kho bo bsgrags so/ /'di sbyar dge tshogs 'od dkar drwa ba/ /rab tu gsal ba gang thob de yis/ /bde gshegs bstan pa kun+da'i phreng ba/ /rnam pa kun tu rgyas par gyur cig /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs kun tu/ /kun dga'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri med/ /lus srog longs spyod kun gyis bsten cing / /gdams pa bzang pos skyong bar shog shig /gdams pa'i don rnams tshul bzhin bsgoms pas/ /gnas dang nye gnas la sogs sa rnams/ /bde blag bgrod nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i/ /sa mchog myur du thob par shog shig /de ma thob kyi gnas skabs kun tu/ /'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag zhi zhing / /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i mthun rkyen tshang ste/

/yang dag bstan pa'i dpal du gyur cig /dpal kyai rdo rje'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rgya cher bshad pa bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer la rtsod pa spong ba gnad kyi gsal byed ces bya ba 'di ni dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi sras kyi thu bo/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi 'dren pa dam pa/ gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa la 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyer ma mchis pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi bstan pa tshul bzhin du 'dzin pa la 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / gting dpag dka' ba'i gnas lugs zab mo 'byed pa'i mkhyen rab dang / 'gro ba thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i thugs rje zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas snyigs dus kyi gdul bya rnams kyi mgon skyabs su gyur pa rje btsun dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa'i yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pas/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la blo kha cung zad phyogs shing / khyad par rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i don la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa thob pa/ mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges/ me pho khyi'i lo sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga la dpal ngam ring gi chos grwa chen por sbyar ba las/ slar yang zhus cing bcos te dag par bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhon nu bzang pos bgyis so// //'dis kyang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gyur cig/ ༄༅/ /'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba gang zhig thob pa des/ /mkha' khyab skye bo thams cad kyis/ /bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bsti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/
